title: Brown Soda Bread
directions: Mix the dry ingredients. Stir in enough buttermilk to make a soft dough.
Shape into a round, cut a cross on top, and bake at 425°F for 40 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped.
story: Hannah baked this every Saturday in a covered pot on the hearth, and the first cut was always for whoever had walked the farthest.

title: Irish Stew
ingredients: 2 pounds neck of lamb, in pieces
directions: Layer the meat, onions and potatoes in a heavy pot, seasoning each layer. Add water to cover.
Simmer very gently for two hours without stirring.
story: Cornelius would not allow carrots in it. 'It is lamb, potato and onion,' he said, 'and that is the whole of it.'

title: Fish Chowder
directions: Fry the pork until crisp. Cook the onions in the fat. Add the potatoes and water to cover; simmer until tender.
Lay the fish on top and cook ten minutes, then pour in the milk and heat without boiling. Serve with crackers.
story: Patrick brought home the day's cheap fish from the docks every Friday, and this is what became of it.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream butter & sugar. Add eggs + vanilla. Mix in dry.

title: Colcannon
directions: Boil and mash the potatoes. Simmer the cabbage and scallions in the milk until soft.
Beat everything together with the butter and serve with a pool of butter in the middle.
story: Nora hid a ring in it every Halloween. Whoever found it was supposed to marry within the year; nobody ever did.

title: Bridget's recipe card
story: Her handwriting, on the back of a laundry list.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Slice the apples and toss with the sugar, flour and cinnamon. Fill the crust, dot with butter, and cover.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, then 350°F for 40 minutes.
story: Mary made two every Sunday and gave one away, usually to whoever had had a bad week.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Boil potatoes and onion in water 20 min. until soft.
Add milk and butter. Season. Serves 6.

title: Pfeffernüsse
ingredients: pinch each of cloves, nutmeg and pepper
directions: Beat the eggs and sugar until pale, fold in the rest, and chill overnight.
Roll into small balls and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.
story: They were made in November so they would be hard as stones by Christmas, which Greta insisted was the point.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Parboil the beans. Put the onion and pork in the pot, add the beans, and pour over the molasses, sugar and mustard in hot water.
Bake covered at 300°F for six hours, adding water as needed.
story: Saturday night, every Saturday night, for fifty years, with brown bread from a can.
